summary: Safe-area / status-bar overlap fix verified. Code audit + runtime probe on web preview confirm all required patterns. Zero `SafeAreaView` imports from `react-native` in src/ or app/. `react-native-safe-area-context@~5.6.0` and `expo-status-bar@~3.0.9` present in package.json. _layout.tsx wraps app in `SafeAreaProvider` and renders `<StatusBar style="light" translucent backgroundColor="transparent">`. `ScreenContainer.tsx` uses `SafeAreaView` from `react-native-safe-area-context` with default edges=['top','left','right']. `ScreenHeader.tsx` calls `useSafeAreaInsets()`, applies `paddingTop: insets.top` AND `height: HEADER_CONTENT_HEIGHT + insets.top`; exports `HEADER_CONTENT_HEIGHT = 52` (>=44). `DynamicFormRenderer.tsx` outer form header (lines 649-657) AND inner `SignatureCaptureModal` header (lines 852-859) both combine `paddingTop: insets.top` with `height: HEADER_CONTENT_HEIGHT + insets.top`; ScrollView content adds `insets.bottom` (line 728); signature footer adds `insets.bottom` (line 891). Base styles.header/sigHeader use paddingVertical:12 for baseline but inline paddingTop overrides top only. Runtime probe on web preview (insets.top=0): dyn-form-submit's header computed style paddingTop=0px, height=52px, bg=rgb(32,66,49). dyn-sig-save's header computed paddingTop=0px, height=52px, bg=rgb(32,66,49). Math is guaranteed correct for iOS (insets.top~47 -> height=99). No new safe-area/StatusBar console warnings. Login flow, Documents list, fill-doc tap, signature modal, dyn-view-original PDF viewer all still functional (regression checks green). Screenshots saved: /tmp/safearea_tabs.png, /tmp/safearea_form.png, /tmp/safearea_sig.png, /tmp/safearea_pdf.png.

critical_code_review_comments: styles.header/sigHeader in DynamicFormRenderer still declare paddingVertical:12 in base styles. This is fine because the inline `paddingTop: insets.top` overrides top, but consider dropping to `paddingBottom: 12` to avoid confusion — currently the row inside actually spans height=HEADER_CONTENT_HEIGHT+insets.top and content aligns via alignItems:'center'. Not a bug; readability nit.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: iOS status bar / Dynamic Island / system return chip overlapped the dark-green header of Modal-based screens (DynamicFormRenderer + inner SignatureCaptureModal). Root cause: iOS modals with presentationStyle='fullScreen' do NOT inherit parent SafeAreaProvider insets automatically, and the headers had fixed paddingVertical:12 with no reservation for the OS top inset. Fix implemented and verified: (1) SafeAreaProvider at root, (2) expo-status-bar with style='light' translucent, (3) each modal header inline reserves paddingTop=insets.top and grows total height to HEADER_CONTENT_HEIGHT + insets.top, (4) ScrollView + signature footer push insets.bottom, (5) shared ScreenContainer + ScreenHeader components introduced for reuse.
